name: EGEN 3120
title: Teaching and Learning in School Contexts
description: Integration of concepts of designing and planning instructional activities to support diverse student learning with clinical experiences.
requirement_description: EGEN 3100; open only to students in the Integrated Bachelor's/Master's Elementary Teacher Preparation Program. Not open for credit to students who have passed EGEN 3110. May not be taken out of sequence after passing EGEN 4200.
